# Coastal Raid

*Page PDF 17*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

## **Coastal Raid Hard Encounter**
In this scenario, Flariel’s Reavers launch a full-scale attack on an unsuspecting Human village on the coast of the Empire or Bretonnia. They intend to torment the villagers for a time, steal any valuables, capture the population, then take them back to the Temple of Spite, delighting in inflicting terror and mayhem on a pathetic lesser species. 

Captain Flariel chooses targets carefully. The Dark Elves will not attack a village with a population larger than 75, substantial defences, or a heavy military presence. After laying anchor in a nearby bay, the Druchii row boats to the shore at sunset, with lookouts leading the way to scout the village’s defences. As night falls, the corsairs and several sailors creep towards the village and kill anyone outside the stockade (or equivalent). They use crossbows to pick off any conspicuous guards, then Flariel calls out that he and his crew will raze the village and kill any who resist capture. 

The Reavers delay their assault to savour the terror of the Humans within. The corsairs and sailors surround the walls, with Rakaria, Corvian, and Flariel roughly equally distant from one another around the perimeter. Anyone attempting to leave will be killed or captured. Anyone attempting to enter meets a more horrific fate … at daybreak, a cart crashes into the village driven by the few remaining wretched survivors of a group who attempted to break out of the village a few days earlier. With each passing hour, the Dark Elves engineer more terrifying spectacles to intimidate the villagers into surrender. 

Characters can help the villagers in several ways. If they want to 

attempt a military response (from within or outside the village), they could muster the scrappy militia and organise retaliation against the less numerous but more adept Dark Elves. (GMs with access to **Archives of the Empire Volume II** may make use of the Mass Combat rules to run a battle against them.) However, there are more cunning options… 

Captain Flariel’s insistence on drawing out the siege enrages Corvian and several of the sailors, who hunger for slaughter. If they can find a means to destroy Flariel, they will try. Rakaria joined the raid, though as time drags on, she loses interest and may return to the ship or use the opportunity to kill Corvian. 

Back on the Raptor’s Talon, Flariel recklessly left only seven sailors and Medus Hackwind to defend the vessel and oversee the captives. Stealthy Characters could row out to the vessel and free the oarsmen, who will rally under Cynwra’s leadership to wreak revenge on their Druchii persecutors. 

Several miles from the village stands a coastal beacon. If the Characters light it, they attract the attention of a passing Empire Wolfship, loaded with marines and a contingent of Sons of Manann templars. 

The raiding force consists of: 

- Captain Flariel accompanied by 8 Corsairs and 1 Lookout. 

- Rakaria accompanied by 6 Corsairs and 5 Ship’s Crew. 

- Corvian with their 4 hounds, 6 Corsairs, 3 Ship’s Crew, and 1 Lookout. 

Remaining on board the Raptor’s Talon are: 

- Medus Hackwind (Chief Mate) and 7 Ship’s Crew. 

- 30 captive Oarsmen.
